intro.en: Two students meet at a language institute. One studied Arabic for four years at school but cannot speak it well. Her friend gives her advice: memorise verses of the Quran and speak a lot.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein do talibaat ki guftagu hai. Ek ne school mein chaar saal Arabi padhi lekin bolna nahin aata. Dost use mashwara deti hai: Quran ki ayaat yaad karo aur zyada bolo.
intro.ar: طالِبَتانِ تَلْتَقِيانِ في مَعْهَدِ لُغَةٍ. إِحْداهُما دَرَسَتِ العَرَبِيَّةَ أَرْبَعَ سَنَواتٍ في المَدْرَسَةِ وَلا تَتَكَلَّمُها جَيِّداً، فَتَنْصَحُها صَديقَتُها بِحِفْظِ آياتٍ مِنَ القُرْآنِ وَكَثْرَةِ الكَلامِ.

dialogue.ar: أَظُنُّكِ طالِبَةً جَديدَةً في المَعْهَدِ، فَلَمْ أَرَكِ مِنْ قَبْلُ.
dialogue.tr: aẓunnuki ṭālibatan jadīdatan fī l-maʿhad, falam araki min qabl
dialogue.en: I think you are a new student at the institute, as I have not seen you before.
dialogue.ur: Mera khayal hai aap institute mein nayi talibah hain, kyunke maine aapko pehle nahin dekha.

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، أَنا هُنا مُنْذُ أُسْبوعٍ؛ فَقَدِ التَحَقْتُ بِالمَعْهَدِ بَعْدَ وُصولي مُباشَرَةً.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, anā hunā mundhu usbūʿ faqadi t-taḥaqtu bil-maʿhadi baʿda wuṣūlī mubāshara
dialogue.en: Yes, I have been here for a week; I joined the institute right after I arrived.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, mujhe yahan ek hafta hua hai; pahunchte hi maine institute mein dakhila le liya.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ أَيِّ بَلَدٍ جِئْتِ، وَهَلْ تَعَلَّمْتِ العَرَبِيَّةَ هُناكَ؟
dialogue.tr: min ayyi baladin jiʾt, wahal taʿallamti l-ʿarabiyyata hunāk?
dialogue.en: Which country did you come from, and did you learn Arabic there?
dialogue.ur: Aap kis mulk se aayi hain, aur kya aapne wahan Arabi seekhi?

dialogue.ar: جِئْتُ مِنْ كَنَدا، وَدَرَسْتُ العَرَبِيَّةَ في مَدْرَسَةٍ أَرْبَعَ سَنَواتٍ.
dialogue.tr: jiʾtu min kanadā, wadarastu l-ʿarabiyyata fī madrasatin arbaʿa sanawt
dialogue.en: I came from Canada, and I studied Arabic at a school for four years.
dialogue.ur: Main Canada se aayi hoon, aur maine school mein chaar saal Arabi parhi.

dialogue.ar: أَرْبَعُ سَنَواتٍ! إِذَنْ لِماذا تَدْرُسينَ العَرَبِيَّةَ هُنا مَرَّةً ثانِيَةً؟
dialogue.tr: arbaʿu sanawt idhan limādhā tadrusīna l-ʿarabiyyata hunā marratan thāniya?
dialogue.en: Four years! Then why are you studying Arabic here a second time?
dialogue.ur: Chaar saal! To phir aap yahan dobara Arabi kyun parh rahi hain?

dialogue.ar: كُنّا نَقْرَأُ النُّصوصَ وَنَحْفَظُ القَواعِدَ وَنَكْتُبُ التَّرْجَمَةَ، وَلا نَتَكَلَّمُ إِلّا قَليلاً.
dialogue.tr: kunnā naqraʾu n-nuṣūṣa wanaḥfaẓu l-qawʿida wanaktubu t-tarjama, walā natakallamu illā qalīlan
dialogue.en: We used to read texts, memorise grammar and write translations, and we hardly spoke at all.
dialogue.ur: Hum matn parhte, qawaid yaad karte aur tarjuma likhte the, aur bolte bohat kam the.

dialogue.ar: هَذا مَعْروفٌ؛ فَالحَديثُ يَحْتاجُ إِلى تَدْريبٍ كَبيرٍ.
dialogue.tr: hādhā maʿrūf fal-ḥadīthu yaḥtāju ilā tadrībin kabīr
dialogue.en: That is well known; speaking needs a lot of practice.
dialogue.ur: Ye aam baat hai; bolne ke liye bohat mashq chahiye.

dialogue.ar: حينَ أَتَكَلَّمُ لا أَجِدُ الكَلِماتِ، وَلا أَفْهَمُ المُعَلِّمَةَ إِذا تَكَلَّمَتْ بِسُرْعَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: ḥīna atakallamu lā ajidu l-kalimāt, walā afhamu l-muʿallimata idhā takallamat bisurʿa
dialogue.en: When I speak I cannot find the words, and I do not understand the teacher if she speaks fast.
dialogue.ur: Jab main bolti hoon to mujhe alfaaz nahin milte, aur agar ustaani tez bolen to samajh nahin aata.

dialogue.ar: في المَعْهَدِ مُخْتَبَرٌ لِلُّغَةِ وَمَكْتَبَةٌ وَإِذاعَةٌ وَحاسوبٌ، وَيُمْكِنُكِ أَنْ تَسْتَفيدي مِنْها كُلِّها.
dialogue.tr: fī l-maʿhadi mukhtabarun lillughati wamaktabatun waʾidhāʿatun waḥāsūb, wayumkinuki an tastafīdī minhā kullihā
dialogue.en: The institute has a language lab, a library, a radio and a computer, and you can benefit from all of them.
dialogue.ur: Institute mein language lab, library, radio aur computer hai, aur aap in sab se faida utha sakti hain.

dialogue.ar: وَعِنْدي مُشْكِلَةٌ في النُّطْقِ؛ فَلا أَنْطِقُ حَرْفَ الضّادِ وَحَرْفَ الخاءِ جَيِّداً.
dialogue.tr: waʿindī mushkilatun fī n-nuṭq falā anṭiqu ḥarfa ḍ-ḍādi waḥarfa l-khāʾi jayyidan
dialogue.en: I also have a problem with pronunciation; I cannot pronounce the letters Dad and Kha well.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe talaffuz mein bhi masla hai; main harf Daad aur Khaa theek se ada nahin kar pati.

dialogue.ar: اِذْهَبي إِلى المُخْتَبَرِ، فَفيهِ تَدْريباتٌ صَوْتِيَّةٌ مُفيدَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: idhhabī ilā l-mukhtabar, fafīhi tadrībātun ṣawtiyyatun mufīda
dialogue.en: Go to the lab, as it has useful sound exercises.
dialogue.ur: Lab mein jayein, wahan awaazon ki mufeed mashqein hain.

dialogue.ar: سَأَذْهَبُ غَداً. وَلَكِنْ ماذا أَفْعَلُ لِأَتَعَلَّمَ العَرَبِيَّةَ بِسُرْعَةٍ؟
dialogue.tr: saʾadhhabu ghadan walakin mādhā afʿalu liʾataʿallama l-ʿarabiyyata bisurʿa?
dialogue.en: I will go tomorrow. But what should I do to learn Arabic quickly?
dialogue.ur: Main kal jaungi. Lekin Arabi jaldi seekhne ke liye main kya karun?

dialogue.ar: اِحْفَظي آياتٍ مِنَ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ، وَتَكَلَّمي مَعَ زَميلاتِكِ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ وَلَوْ أَخْطَأْتِ.
dialogue.tr: iḥfaẓī ʾāītin mina l-qurʾāni l-karīmi kulla yawm, watakallamī maʿa zamīlātiki bil-ʿarabiyyati walaw akhṭaʾt
dialogue.en: Memorise verses of the Noble Quran every day, and speak Arabic with your classmates even if you make mistakes.
dialogue.ur: Roz Quran-e-Kareem ki kuch ayaat yaad karein, aur saheliyon se Arabi mein baat karein chahe ghalti ho jaye.

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً يا نورَةُ، هَذِهِ نَصيحَةٌ مُفيدَةٌ جِدّاً، وَسَأَتَّبِعُها كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
dialogue.tr: shukran yā nūra, hādhihi naṣīḥatun mufīdatun jiddan, wasaʾattabiʿuhā kulla yawm
dialogue.en: Thank you, Noura, this is very useful advice, and I will follow it every day.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya Noura, ye bohat mufeed nasihat hai, aur main roz is par amal karungi.

dialogue.ar: وَسَتَرَيْنَ نَتيجَتَها قَريباً.
dialogue.tr: wasatarayna natījatahā qarīban
dialogue.en: And you will see its result soon.
dialogue.ur: Aur aap jald hi iska nateeja dekhengi.

q.ur: «مَعْهَد» ka matlab kya hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَكاناً نَتَعَلَّمُ فيهِ اللُّغَةَ؟

q.en: The second student advises her to memorise:
q.ur: Doosri talibah use kya yaad karne ka mashwara deti hai?
«نَصيحَةٌ مُفيدَةٌ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: How many years did she study Arabic at school?
q.ur: Usne school mein kitne saal Arabi parhi?
q.ar: كَمْ سَنَةً دَرَسَتِ العَرَبِيَّةَ في المَدْرَسَةِ؟

title.en: The connecting and the cutting hamzah

intro.en: The cutting hamzah (همزة القطع) is pronounced at the start of speech and also when joined to a word before it. The connecting hamzah (همزة الوصل) is pronounced only at the start, and is dropped when joined. Example: اِجْلِسْ (start) but وَاجْلِسْ (joined: the hamzah disappears).
intro.ur: Hamzat-ul-qat shuru mein bhi aur beech mein bhi bolta hai. Hamzat-ul-wasl sirf shuru mein bolta hai, jab kisi lafz se mil jaye to gir jata hai. Misal: اِجْلِسْ lekin وَاجْلِسْ.
intro.ar: هَمْزَةُ القَطْعِ تُنْطَقُ في أَوَّلِ الكَلامِ وَفي وَسَطِهِ. أَمّا هَمْزَةُ الوَصْلِ فَتُنْطَقُ في أَوَّلِ الكَلامِ فَقَط وَتَسْقُطُ إِذا اتَّصَلَتْ بِما قَبْلَها. مِثالٌ: اِجْلِسْ، وَلَكِنْ: وَاجْلِسْ.

q.en: Which hamzah is NOT pronounced when joined to the word before it?
q.ur: Pichhle lafz se milne par kaun sa hamzah nahin bola jata?
q.ar: أَيُّ هَمْزَةٍ لا تُنْطَقُ إِذا اتَّصَلَتْ بِالكَلِمَةِ قَبْلَها؟

q.ur: «أَكْتُبُ» mein hamzah kaisa hai?
«اِسْتَمِعْ» mein hamzah kaisa hai?
«أَجْلِسُ» kis se shuru hota hai?

intro.en: الَّذي (alladhī) joins a sentence to a masculine singular noun, and الَّتي (allatī) to a feminine singular noun. It means 'who / which / that'. Example: رَجَعَ الطَّالِبُ الَّذي سافَرَ – the student who travelled came back.
intro.ur: الَّذي mard/muzakkar wahid ke liye aur الَّتي aurat/muannas wahid ke liye aata hai. Matlab: jo / jis ne. Misal: رَجَعَ الطَّالِبُ الَّذي سافَرَ – woh talib-e-ilm laut aaya jo safar par gaya tha.
intro.ar: «الَّذي» لِلْمُفْرَدِ المُذَكَّرِ وَ«الَّتي» لِلْمُفْرَدِ المُؤَنَّثِ، وَهُما يَرْبِطانِ الجُمْلَةَ بِالاسْمِ قَبْلَهُما. مِثالٌ: رَجَعَ الطّالِبُ الَّذي سافَرَ.

q.en: Which relative noun is used with a feminine singular noun?
q.ur: Muannas wahid ke saath kaun sa ism-e-mausool aata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ اسْمٍ مَوْصولٍ نَسْتَعْمِلُهُ مَعَ المُفْرَدِ المُؤَنَّثِ؟

q.ur: Mukammal karein: عادَتِ الطَّالِبَةُ ___ سافَرَتْ.

q.en: Complete: هَذا هُوَ الرَّجُلُ ___ يُحِبُّ دينَهُ.
q.ur: Mukammal karein: هَذا هُوَ الرَّجُلُ ___ يُحِبُّ دينَهُ.
q.ar: أَكْمِلْ: هَذا هُوَ الرَّجُلُ ___ يُحِبُّ دينَهُ.

q.en: What comes after الَّذي and الَّتي?
q.ur: الَّذي aur الَّتي ke baad kya aata hai?

intro.en: Listen to a dialogue and mark each sentence right or wrong. Then practise asking a classmate questions about languages: your first language, how many languages you speak, and why you are learning Arabic.
intro.ur: Guftagu sun kar har jumle ko sahi ya ghalat batayein. Phir apne sathi se zubanon ke bare mein sawal poochhein: aap ki pehli zubaan, kitni zubanein bolte hain, Arabi kyun seekh rahe hain.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى حِوارٍ وَحَدِّدْ صَوابَ كُلِّ جُمْلَةٍ أَوْ خَطَأَها. ثُمَّ اسْأَلْ زَميلَكَ عَنِ اللُّغاتِ: لُغَتِهِ الأولى، وَعَدَدِ اللُّغاتِ الَّتي يَتَكَلَّمُها، وَسَبَبِ تَعَلُّمِهِ العَرَبِيَّةَ.

q.en: How do you ask 'What is your first language?'
q.ur: «Aap ki pehli zubaan kya hai?» kaise poochhenge?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ عَنِ اللُّغَةِ الأولى لِصَديقِكَ؟

q.ur: «لِماذا تَتَعَلَّمُ العَرَبِيَّةَ؟» kya poochta hai?
«الأُمّ» ka matlab:
«مَتى بَدَأْتَ؟» ka matlab:

intro.en: This reading is about how Arabic began among the tribes of Arabia, how the Quran was revealed in Fusha (classical) Arabic, and how Arabic influenced the languages of Muslim peoples such as Persian, Urdu and Swahili.
intro.ur: Is parhne mein bataya gaya hai ke Arabi Jazeera-e-Arab mein kaise shuru hui, Quran Fusha Arabi mein nazil hua, aur Arabi ne Farsi, Urdu aur Swahili jaisi zubanon par asar dala.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنْ نَشْأَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ بَيْنَ قَبائِلِ جَزيرَةِ العَرَبِ، وَنُزولِ القُرْآنِ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ الفُصْحى، وَأَثَرِها في لُغاتِ الشُّعوبِ المُسْلِمَةِ كَالفارِسِيَّةِ وَالأُرْدِيَّةِ وَالسّواحِلِيَّةِ.

dialogue.ar: بَدَأَتِ العَرَبِيَّةُ تَنْمو في جَزيرَةِ العَرَبِ قَبْلَ ظُهورِ الإِسْلامِ بِزَمَنٍ طَويلٍ.
dialogue.tr: badaʾati l-ʿarabiyyatu tanmū fī jazīrati l-ʿarabi qabla ẓuhūri l-islāmi bizamanin ṭawīl
dialogue.en: Arabic began to grow in the Arabian Peninsula a long time before Islam appeared.
dialogue.ur: Arabi Jazeera-e-Arab mein Islam ke zahoor se bohat pehle parwan charhne lagi.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَتْ كُلُّ قَبيلَةٍ تَتَكَلَّمُ بِلَهْجَةٍ فيها فُروقٌ قَليلَةٌ، وَلَكِنَّ لِلْجَميعِ لُغَةً مُشْتَرَكَةً.
dialogue.tr: wakānat kullu qabīlatin tatakallamu bilahjatin fīhā furūqun qalīla, walakinna lil-jamīʿi lughatan mushtaraka
dialogue.en: Each tribe spoke with a dialect that had small differences, but all of them had a common language.
dialogue.ur: Har qabeela thore se farq wali boli bolta tha, lekin sab ki ek mushtarak zubaan thi.

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ اللُّغَةُ المُشْتَرَكَةُ هِيَ الفُصْحى، وَبِها كانَ الشُّعَراءُ يُنْشِدونَ الشِّعْرَ وَالخُطَباءُ يُلْقونَ الخَطابَةَ.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi l-lughatu l-mushtarakatu hiya l-fuṣḥā, wabihā kāna sh-shuʿarāʾu yunshidūna sh-shiʿra wal-khuṭabāʾu yulqūna l-khaṭāba
dialogue.en: This common language is Fusha; poets recited poetry in it and speakers gave their speeches in it.
dialogue.ur: Ye mushtarak zubaan Fusha hai; shuara isi mein shayri sunate aur khutaba isi mein khitab karte the.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنْزَلَ اللهُ تَعالى القُرْآنَ الكَريمَ بِلِسانٍ عَرَبِيٍّ فَصيحٍ.
dialogue.tr: waʾanzala llāh taʿālā l-qurʾāna l-karīma bilisānin ʿarabiyyin faṣīḥ
dialogue.en: And Allah the Most High sent down the Noble Quran in eloquent Arabic speech.
dialogue.ur: Aur Allah Ta'ala ne Quran-e-Kareem fasih Arabi zubaan mein nazil farmaya.

dialogue.ar: قالَ اللهُ تَعالى: ﴿إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ [يوسف: ٢]
dialogue.tr: qāla llāhu taʿālā: innā anzalnāhu qurʾānan ʿarabiyyan laʿallakum taʿqilūn (Yūsuf: 2)
dialogue.en: Allah the Most High said: We have sent it down as an Arabic Quran so that you may understand. (Yusuf: 2)
dialogue.ur: Allah Taala ne farmaya: Hum ne ise Arabi Quran banakar utara taake tum samjho. (Yusuf: 2)

dialogue.ar: وَحَمَلَ القُرْآنُ إِلى العَرَبِ مَعانِيَ جَديدَةً لِبَعْضِ الكَلِماتِ القَديمَةِ.
dialogue.tr: waḥamala l-qurʾānu ilā l-ʿarabi maʿāniya jadīdatan libaʿḍi l-kalimāti l-qadīma
dialogue.en: The Quran brought the Arabs new meanings for some of the old words.
dialogue.ur: Quran ne Arabon ko kuch purane alfaaz ke naye maani diye.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ أَجْلِ فَهْمِ القُرْآنِ نَشَأَتْ عُلومُ اللُّغَةِ: النَّحْوُ وَالصَّرْفُ وَالبَلاغَةُ، ثُمَّ ظَهَرَتْ عُلومُ التَّفْسيرِ وَالحَديثِ وَالفِقْهِ وَالعَقيدَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wamin ajli fahmi l-qurʾāni nashaʾat ʿulūmu l-lugha an-naḥwu waṣ-ṣarfu wal-balāgha, thumma ẓaharat ʿulūmu t-tafsīri wal-ḥadīthi wal-fiqhi wal-ʿaqīda
dialogue.en: For the sake of understanding the Quran the language sciences arose: grammar, morphology and rhetoric, and then the sciences of tafsir, hadith, fiqh and creed appeared.
dialogue.ur: Quran ko samajhne ke liye zubaan ke uloom wujood mein aaye: nahw, sarf aur balaghat, phir tafseer, hadees, fiqh aur aqeedah ke uloom saamne aaye.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ أَثَّرَتِ العَرَبِيَّةُ في لُغاتِ المُسْلِمينَ، فَاقْتَرَضَتْ مِنْها الأُرْدِيَّةُ وَالفارِسِيَّةُ وَالسَّواحِلِيَّةُ أَلْفاظاً كَثيرَةً، وَكُتِبَتْ بَعْضُ هَذِهِ اللُّغاتِ بِالحَرْفِ العَرَبِيِّ.
dialogue.tr: waqad aththarati l-ʿarabiyyatu fī lughāti l-muslimīn, fāqtaraḍat minhā l-urdiyyatu wal-fārisiyyatu was-sawḥiliyatu alfāẓan kathīra, wakutibat baʿḍu hādhihi l-lughāti bil-ḥarfi l-ʿarabiyy
dialogue.en: Arabic influenced the languages of the Muslims: Urdu, Persian and Swahili borrowed many words from it, and some of these languages came to be written in the Arabic script.
dialogue.ur: Arabi ne Musalmanon ki zubanon par asar dala: Urdu, Farsi aur Swahili ne is se bohat se alfaaz liye, aur kuch zubanein Arabi harf mein likhi jane lagin.

dialogue.ar: وَأَخَذَتْ لُغاتٌ أُخْرى، مِنْها الإِسْبانِيَّةُ وَالإِنْجِليزِيَّةُ، كَلِماتٍ عَرَبِيَّةً أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: waʾakhadhat lughātun ukhrā, minhā l-isbāniyyatu wal-injilīziyya, kalimātin ʿarabiyyatan ayḍan
dialogue.en: Other languages, among them Spanish and English, also took Arabic words.
dialogue.ur: Doosri zubanon ne bhi, jin mein Spanish aur English shamil hain, Arabi alfaaz liye.

q.en: In which language was the Quran revealed?
q.ur: Quran kis zubaan mein nazil hua?
Arabi zubaan kahan shuru hui?

q.en: Which is one of the Arabic-language sciences?
q.ur: Arabi zubaan ke ulum mein se kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيٌّ مِمّا يَأْتي مِنْ عُلومِ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ؟

q.en: Which language borrowed words from Arabic?
q.ur: Kis zubaan ne Arabi se alfaaz liye?
q.ar: أَيُّ لُغَةٍ اقْتَبَسَتْ كَلِماتٍ مِنَ العَرَبِيَّةِ؟

intro.en: كانَ is an incomplete past verb. It enters a noun sentence: the subject stays raised and is now called its اسْم (ism), and the predicate becomes accusative and is called its خَبَر (khabar). Its sisters: صارَ، لَيْسَ، أَصْبَحَ، ظَلَّ، ما زالَ. Example: كانَ العَرَبُ قَبائِلَ – the Arabs were tribes.
intro.ur: كانَ ek naqis fe'l hai jo jumla ismiya par aata hai: mubtada marfoo rehta hai (ism kaana) aur khabar mansoob ho jati hai (khabar kaana). Behnein: صارَ، لَيْسَ، أَصْبَحَ، ظَلَّ، ما زالَ. Misal: كانَ العَرَبُ قَبائِلَ.
intro.ar: «كانَ» فِعْلٌ ناقِصٌ يَدْخُلُ عَلى الجُمْلَةِ الاسْمِيَّةِ، فَيَبْقى المُبْتَدَأُ مَرْفوعاً وَيُسَمّى اسْمَها، وَيَصيرُ الخَبَرُ مَنْصوباً وَيُسَمّى خَبَرَها. مِنْ أَخَواتِها: صارَ، لَيْسَ، أَصْبَحَ، ظَلَّ، ما زالَ. مِثالٌ: كانَ العَرَبُ قَبائِلَ.

q.en: The subject after كانَ is called:
q.ur: كانَ ke baad mubtada ko kya kehte hain?

q.en: Which is NOT a sister of كانَ?
q.ur: Inmein se kaana ki behan kaun si nahin?

q.en: The khabar of كانَ is in which case?
q.ur: Khabar-e-kaana kis halat mein hota hai?
q.ar: خَبَرُ «كانَ» يَكونُ في أَيِّ حالَةٍ إِعْرابِيَّةٍ؟

q.en: Choose the correct form: صارَ الجَوُّ ___
q.ur: Durust shakl chunein: صارَ الجَوُّ ___
«ما زالَ» ka matlab:

intro.en: Two men, Anas and Sulayman, meet at the airport and talk about where they are travelling to study. Notice the polite goodbyes at the end: مَعَ السَّلامَةِ and في أَمانِ اللهِ.
intro.ur: Anas aur Sulayman ki hawai adde par mulaqat hoti hai aur woh batate hain ke ilm ke liye kahan ja rahe hain. Aakhir mein alvida ke adaab dekhein: مَعَ السَّلامَةِ aur في أَمانِ اللهِ.
intro.ar: رَجُلانِ، أَنَسٌ وَسُلَيْمانُ، يَلْتَقِيانِ في المَطارِ وَيَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنِ المَكانِ الَّذي يُسافِرانِ إِلَيْهِ لِلدِّراسَةِ. اِنْتَبِهْ إِلى عِباراتِ الوَداعِ في آخِرِ الحِوارِ: مَعَ السَّلامَةِ وَفي أَمانِ اللهِ.

dialogue.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: as-salāmu ʿalaykum waraḥmatu llāh
dialogue.en: Peace and Allah's mercy be upon you.
dialogue.ur: Assalamu alaikum wa rahmatullah.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكاتُهُ.
dialogue.tr: waʿalaykumu s-salāmu waraḥmatu llāh wabarakātuh
dialogue.en: And upon you be peace, Allah's mercy and His blessings.
dialogue.ur: Wa alaikum assalam wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.

dialogue.ar: يَبْدو أَنَّكَ مُسافِرٌ مِثْلي. إِلى أَيِّ مَدينَةٍ تُسافِرُ؟
dialogue.tr: yabdū annaka musāfirun mithlī ilā ayyi madīnatin tusāfir?
dialogue.en: It seems you are travelling like me. To which city are you travelling?
dialogue.ur: Lagta hai aap bhi meri tarah musafir hain. Aap kis shehar ja rahe hain?

dialogue.ar: وِجْهَتي عَمّانُ، وَهُناكَ سَأَلْتَحِقُ بِكُلِّيَّةِ الآدابِ في الجامِعَةِ الأُرْدُنِيَّةِ. وَأَنْتَ؟
dialogue.tr: wijhatī ʿammān, wahunāka saʾaltaḥiqu bikulliyyati l-ʾādābi fī l-jāmiʿati l-urduniyya waʾant?
dialogue.en: My destination is Amman, where I will join the College of Arts at the University of Jordan. And you?
dialogue.ur: Meri manzil Amman hai, jahan main Jordan University ki Kulliyat-ul-Adaab mein dakhila lunga. Aur aap?

dialogue.ar: وِجْهَتي المَدينَةُ المُنَوَّرَةُ، حَيْثُ سَأَلْتَحِقُ بِكُلِّيَّةِ الشَّريعَةِ في الجامِعَةِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ، وَأَرْجو أَنْ أَتَخَصَّصَ في الدِّراساتِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: wijhatī l-madīnatu l-munawwara, ḥaythu saʾaltaḥiqu bikulliyyati sh-sharīʿati fī l-jāmiʿati l-islāmiyya, waʾarjū an atakhaṣṣaṣa fī d-dirāsāti l-islāmiyya
dialogue.en: My destination is Medina, where I will join the College of Sharia at the Islamic University, and I hope to specialise in Islamic studies.
dialogue.ur: Meri manzil Madina Munawwara hai, jahan main Islamic University ki Kulliyat-ush-Shariah mein dakhila lunga, aur umeed hai ke Islami uloom mein takhassus karun.

dialogue.ar: وَلَكِنَّكَ تَحْفَظُ القُرْآنَ وَتَعْرِفُ كَثيراً مِنْ أُمورِ الدّينِ.
dialogue.tr: walakinnaka taḥfaẓu l-qurʾāna wataʿrifu kathīran min umūri d-dīn
dialogue.en: But you memorise the Quran and you know a lot about matters of religion.
dialogue.ur: Lekin aap Quran hifz karte hain aur deen ki bohat si baatein jaante hain.

dialogue.ar: دَرَسْتُ ذَلِكَ بِالإِنْجِليزِيَّةِ في بَلَدي، وَهَذا وَحْدَهُ لا يَكْفي. يَجِبُ أَنْ أَتَعَلَّمَ العَرَبِيَّةَ جَيِّداً، فَهِيَ لُغَةُ الأَحاديثِ وَالتَّفْسيرِ. وَأَنْتَ، ما تَخَصُّصُكَ في كُلِّيَّةِ الآدابِ؟
dialogue.tr: darastu dhālika bil-injilīziyyati fī baladī, wahadhā waḥdahu lā yakfī yajibu an ataʿallama l-ʿarabiyyata jayyidan, fahiya lughatu l-aḥādīthi wat-tafsīr waʾant, mā takhaṣṣuṣuka fī kulliyyati l-ʾādāb?
dialogue.en: I studied that in English in my country, and this alone is not enough. I must learn Arabic well, for it is the language of the hadiths and tafsir. And you, what is your specialisation in the College of Arts?
dialogue.ur: Maine ye sab apne mulk mein English mein parha, aur sirf itna kaafi nahin. Mujhe Arabi achhi tarah seekhni chahiye, kyunke ye hadees aur tafseer ki zubaan hai. Aur aap, Kulliyat-ul-Adaab mein aapka takhassus kya hai?

dialogue.ar: سَأَدْرُسُ الأَدَبَ العَرَبِيَّ وَعُلومَ اللُّغَةِ، وَأُحِبُّ الشِّعْرَ كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: saʾadrusu l-adaba l-ʿarabiyya waʿulūma l-lugha, waʾuḥibbu ash-shiʿra kathīran
dialogue.en: I will study Arabic literature and the language sciences, and I love poetry very much.
dialogue.ur: Main Arabi adab aur zubaan ke uloom parhunga, aur mujhe shayri se bohat pyar hai.

dialogue.ar: وَما هَدَفُكَ بَعْدَ التَّخَرُّجِ؟
dialogue.tr: wamā hadafuka baʿda t-takharuj?
dialogue.en: And what is your goal after graduating?
dialogue.ur: Aur graduation ke baad aapka maqsad kya hai?

dialogue.ar: سَأَعودُ مُدَرِّساً لِلُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ في مَدْرَسَةِ قَرْيَتي، إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ، وَأُعَلِّمُ الأَطْفالَ لُغَةً صَحيحَةً.
dialogue.tr: saʾaʿūdu mudarrisan lillughati l-ʿarabiyyati fī madrasati qaryatī, in shāʾa llāh, waʾuʿallimu l-aṭfāla lughatan ṣaḥīḥa
dialogue.en: I will return as a teacher of Arabic in my village's school, God willing, and teach the children correct language.
dialogue.ur: InshaAllah main apne gaon ke school mein Arabi ka ustaad ban kar laut aaunga aur bachchon ko durust zubaan sikhaunga.

dialogue.ar: اُنْظُرْ، هَذا هُوَ النِّداءُ الأَخيرُ لِطائِرَتي. شُكْراً لَكَ وَجَزاكَ اللهُ خَيْراً.
dialogue.tr: unẓur, hādhā huwa n-nidāʾu l-akhīru liṭāʾiratī shukran laka wajazāka llāh khayran
dialogue.en: Look, this is the last call for my plane. Thank you, and may Allah reward you with good.
dialogue.ur: Dekhiye, ye meri parwaz ka aakhri elaan hai. Shukriya, aur Allah aapko jazaa-e-khair de.

dialogue.ar: عَفْواً، مَعَ السَّلامَةِ يا سُلَيْمانُ.
dialogue.tr: ʿafwan, maʿa s-salāmati yā sulaymān
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Goodbye, Sulayman.
dialogue.ur: Koi baat nahin, Sulayman, khuda hafiz.

dialogue.ar: في أَمانِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: fī amāni llāh
dialogue.en: In Allah's protection.
dialogue.ur: Allah ki hifazat mein.

vocab.en: may Allah reward you with good

q.en: Where is Anas travelling to study?
q.ur: Anas parhne ke liye kahan ja raha hai?

q.en: Which college will Sulayman join in Amman?
q.ur: Sulayman Amman mein kaun si kulliyat mein dakhila lega?
q.ar: بِأَيِّ كُلِّيَّةٍ سَيَلْتَحِقُ سُلَيْمانُ في عَمّانَ؟

q.ur: «في أَمانِ اللهِ» kab kaha jata hai?
«عَفْواً» kis ke jawab mein kaha jata hai?

intro.en: Four letters ( أ ن ي ت ) are put before a verb to make the present tense: أ for 'I', ن for 'we', ي for 'he', ت for 'you / she'. Example: حَضَرَ becomes أَحْضُرُ (I attend), نَحْضُرُ (we attend), يَحْضُرُ (he attends), تَحْضُرُ (you / she attends).
intro.ur: Fe'l-e-muzare banane ke liye chaar huroof (أ ن ي ت) fe'l ke shuru mein lagte hain: أ = main, ن = hum, ي = woh (mard), ت = tum / woh (aurat). Misal: حَضَرَ se أَحْضُرُ، نَحْضُرُ، يَحْضُرُ، تَحْضُرُ.
intro.ar: أَرْبَعَةُ أَحْرُفٍ (أ ن ي ت) نَضَعُها قَبْلَ الفِعْلِ لِنَصْنَعَ المُضارِعَ: الهَمْزَةُ لِلمُتَكَلِّمِ، وَالنُّونُ لِلْمُتَكَلِّمينَ، وَالياءُ لِلْغائِبِ، وَالتّاءُ لِلْمُخاطَبِ أَوِ الغائِبَةِ. مِثالٌ: حَضَرَ ← أَحْضُرُ، نَحْضُرُ، يَحْضُرُ، تَحْضُرُ.

q.en: Which prefix means 'we' in the present tense?
q.ur: Muzare mein «hum» ke liye kaun sa harf hai?
عَرَفَ ka «main» wala muzare:

q.en: Present tense for «هُوَ» uses the prefix:
q.ur: «هُوَ» ke liye muzare ka harf:
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ نَضَعُهُ قَبْلَ المُضارِعِ لِلضَّميرِ «هُوَ»؟

q.ur: «تَحْضُرُ» kis ke liye aa sakta hai?

intro.en: Listen to a text about Rashida, a student who comes to Saudi Arabia to study Islam in Arabic. Then talk with a classmate about borrowed words and what you want to do.
intro.ur: Rashida ka matn suniye jo Islam ko Arabi mein parhne Saudi Arabia aati hai. Phir sathi ke saath udhaar liye gaye alfaaz aur apne iraadon par baat karein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى نَصٍّ عَنْ راشِدَةَ، طالِبَةٍ جاءَتْ إِلى المَمْلَكَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ السُّعودِيَّةِ لِدِراسَةِ الإِسْلامِ بِاللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ. ثُمَّ تَحَدَّثْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ عَنِ الكَلِماتِ المُقْتَرَضَةِ وَعَمّا تُريدُ أَنْ تَفْعَلَ.

q.en: How do you ask 'Did your language borrow words from Arabic?'
q.ur: «Kya aap ki zubaan ne Arabi se alfaaz liye?» kaise poochhenge?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ عَمّا اقْتَرَضَتْهُ لُغَتُكَ مِنَ العَرَبِيَّةِ؟

options: هَلِ اقْتَرَضَتْ لُغَتُكَ أَلْفاظاً مِنَ العَرَبِيَّةِ؟

q.ur: «تُريدُ السَّفَرَ إِلى بَلَدٍ عَرَبِيٍّ» ka matlab:
q.ar: ما مَعْنى «تُريدُ السَّفَرَ إِلى بَلَدٍ عَرَبِيٍّ»؟

options: You want to travel to an Arab country.
You want to study at home.
You want to buy a book.
You do not want to travel.
options_ar: تَرْغَبُ في السَّفَرِ إِلى بَلَدٍ عَرَبِيٍّ.

q.ur: «لُغَةُ القُرْآنِ» kya hai?
«تُريدُ التَّخَصُّصَ» ka matlab:

intro.en: A reading about Arabic as a world language: in the Abbasid age it was the language of science and civilization; later the dialects grew; today Arabic is again a world language and an official language of the United Nations.
intro.ur: Is parhne mein Arabi ko aalmi zubaan ke taur par bataya gaya hai: Abbasi daur mein yeh ilm aur tehzeeb ki zubaan thi, baad mein lehjay barhe, aur aaj yeh phir aalmi zubaan hai aur UN ki sarkari zubanon mein se hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنِ العَرَبِيَّةِ لُغَةً عالَمِيَّةً: كانَتْ في العَصْرِ العَبّاسِيِّ لُغَةَ العِلْمِ وَالحَضارَةِ، ثُمَّ كَثُرَتِ اللَّهَجاتُ، وَهِيَ اليَوْمَ لُغَةٌ عالَمِيَّةٌ وَلُغَةٌ رَسْمِيَّةٌ في هَيْئَةِ الأُمَمِ المُتَّحِدَةِ.

dialogue.ar: في العَصْرِ العَبّاسِيِّ صارَتِ العَرَبِيَّةُ لُغَةً عالَمِيَّةً، فَقَدِ ازْدَهَرَ العِلْمُ في بَغْدادَ ازْدِهاراً كَبيراً.
dialogue.tr: fī l-ʿaṣri l-ʿabbāsiyyi ṣārati l-ʿarabiyyatu lughatan ʿālamiyya, faqadi zdahara l-ʿilmu fī baghdāda zdihāran kabīran
dialogue.en: In the Abbasid era Arabic became a world language, for knowledge flourished greatly in Baghdad.
dialogue.ur: Abbasi daur mein Arabi aalmi zubaan ban gayi, kyunke Baghdad mein ilm khoob phala phoola.

dialogue.ar: تُرْجِمَتْ إِلى العَرَبِيَّةِ كُتُبُ اليونانِيَّةِ وَغَيْرِها، وَكَتَبَ العُلَماءُ بِها في الطِّبِّ وَالهَنْدَسَةِ وَالرِّياضِيّاتِ.
dialogue.tr: turjimat ilā l-ʿarabiyyati kutubu l-īwnāniyyati waghayrihā, wakataba l-ʿulamāʾu bihā fī ṭ-ṭibi wal-handasati war-rīḍiyāt
dialogue.en: Books of the Greek language and others were translated into Arabic, and scholars wrote in it on medicine, engineering and mathematics.
dialogue.ur: Yooni aur doosri zubanon ki kitabein Arabi mein tarjuma huin, aur ulama ne is mein tibb, handasa aur riyazi par likha.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ انْتَقَلَتْ مَعارِفُها إِلى أُوروبّا، فَتَعَلَّمَ مِنْها الأُوروبِّيّونَ.
dialogue.tr: thumma ntaqalat maʿārifuhā ilā ūrūbbā, fataʿallama minhā l-ūrūbbiyyūn
dialogue.en: Then its knowledge moved to Europe, and the Europeans learned from it.
dialogue.ur: Phir uska ilm Europe pahuncha, aur Europe walon ne us se seekha.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ جاءَ زَمَنُ الضَّعْفِ، فَهَجَرَ كَثيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ الفُصْحى وَاسْتَعْمَلوا اللَّهَجاتِ المَحَلِّيَّةَ في كُلِّ شَيْءٍ.
dialogue.tr: wabaʿda dhālika jāʾa zamanu ḍ-ḍaʿf, fahajara kathīrun mina n-nāsi l-fuṣḥā wāstaʿmalū l-lahajāti l-maḥalliyyata fī kulli shayʾ
dialogue.en: After that came a time of weakness, and many people abandoned Fusha and used local dialects for everything.
dialogue.ur: Uske baad kamzori ka daur aaya, to bohat se logon ne Fusha chhor di aur har cheez mein maqami boliyan istemal kin.

dialogue.ar: وَزادَ الاسْتِعْمارُ الأَمْرَ سُوءاً، فَقَلَّلَ مِنْ شَأْنِ العَرَبِيَّةِ في المَدارِسِ وَشَجَّعَ لُغاتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wazāda l-stiʿmāru l-amra sūʾan, faqallala min shaʾni l-ʿarabiyyati fī l-madārisi washajjaʿa lughātih
dialogue.en: Colonialism made matters worse; it belittled Arabic in schools and encouraged its own languages.
dialogue.ur: Istemar ne halat aur bigaad diye; usne school mein Arabi ki ahmiyat kam ki aur apni zubanon ko badhawa diya.

dialogue.ar: وَصارَ العَرَبِيُّ إِذا سافَرَ إِلى بَلَدٍ عَرَبِيٍّ بَعيدٍ يَجِدُ صُعوبَةً في فَهْمِ لَهْجَةِ أَهْلِهِ، وَيَضْعُفُ الاتِّصالُ بَيْنَهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: waṣāra l-ʿarabiyyu idhā sāfara ilā baladin ʿarabiyyin baʿīdin yajidu ṣuʿūbatan fī fahmi lahjati ahlih, wayaḍʿufu l-ttiṣālu baynahum
dialogue.en: An Arab who travelled to a distant Arab country began to find it hard to understand the dialect of its people, and communication between them grew weak.
dialogue.ur: Jab koi Arab kisi door ke Arab mulk jata to wahan ke logon ki boli samajhne mein use mushkil hoti, aur unke darmiyan rabta kamzor ho gaya.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا اليَوْمَ فَقَدْ تَغَيَّرَ هَذا الأَمْرُ؛ فَالتَّعْليمُ وَالتِّلْفازُ وَوَسائِلُ الاتِّصالِ الحَديثَةُ تُقَرِّبُ الفُصْحى مِنَ النّاسِ.
dialogue.tr: ammā l-yawma faqad taghayyara hādhā l-amr fat-taʿlīmu wat-tilfāzu wawasāʾilu l-ttiṣāli l-ḥadīthatu tuqarribu l-fuṣḥā mina n-nās
dialogue.en: Today this has changed; education, television and modern means of communication bring Fusha closer to people.
dialogue.ur: Aaj ye baat badal gayi hai; taleem, television aur rabte ke jadeed zaraye Fusha ko logon ke qareeb la rahe hain.

dialogue.ar: وَعادَتِ العَرَبِيَّةُ لُغَةً عالَمِيَّةً؛ فَهِيَ لُغَةٌ رَسْمِيَّةٌ في هَيْئَةِ الأُمَمِ المُتَّحِدَةِ، وَيَتَكَلَّمُها مَلايينُ البَشَرِ، وَيَقْرَأُ بِها المُسْلِمونَ كَلامَ رَبِّهِمْ في كُلِّ مَكانٍ.
dialogue.tr: waʿādati l-ʿarabiyyatu lughatan ʿālamiyya fahiya lughatun rasmiyyatun fī hayʾati l-umami l-muttaḥida, wayatakallamuhā malāīīnu l-bashar, wayaqraʾu bihā l-muslimūna kalāma rabbihim fī kulli makān
dialogue.en: Arabic has become a world language again; it is an official language in the United Nations, millions of people speak it, and Muslims everywhere recite the words of their Lord in it.
dialogue.ur: Arabi dobara aalmi zubaan ban gayi hai; wo United Nations ki sarkari zubaan hai, karoron log use bolte hain, aur musalman har jagah us mein apne Rab ka kalam parhte hain.

q.en: In which era was Arabic a world language?
q.ur: Arabi kis daur mein aalmi zubaan thi?
q.ar: في أَيِّ عَصْرٍ كانَتِ العَرَبِيَّةُ لُغَةً عالَمِيَّةً؟

q.en: Where did Arabic knowledge travel after the Abbasid age?
q.ur: Abbasi daur ke baad Arabi ilm kahan pahuncha?
q.ar: إِلى أَيْنَ انْتَقَلَتْ مَعارِفُ العَرَبِيَّةِ بَعْدَ العَصْرِ العَبّاسِيِّ؟

q.en: Arabic is an official language of:
q.ur: Arabi kis ki sarkari zubaan hai?

q.en: What did the dialects cause among the Arabs?
q.ur: Lehjon ne Arabon mein kya paida kiya?

intro.en: The na't (adjective) is a word that describes the noun before it, and it follows that noun in its ending (i'rab). Example: طالِبَةٌ جَديدَةٌ – a new student; القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ – the Noble Quran.
intro.ur: Na't woh lafz hai jo pichhle ism ki sifat bayan karta hai aur is ke i'rab mein uski pairvi karta hai. Misal: طالِبَةٌ جَديدَةٌ – nayi talibah; القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ – Quran-e-Kareem.
intro.ar: النَّعْتُ (الصِّفَةُ) كَلِمَةٌ تَصِفُ الاسْمَ قَبْلَها وَتَتْبَعُهُ في إِعْرابِهِ. مِثالٌ: طالِبَةٌ جَديدَةٌ، القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ.

q.ur: «طالِبَةٌ جَديدَةٌ» mein sifat kaun si hai?
«الأَحاديثِ النَّبَوِيَّةِ» mein sifat:

q.en: The adjective follows the noun in:
q.ur: Sifat kis cheez mein ism ki pairvi karti hai?
Sifat chunein: هَذا قِطارٌ ___
«الكِتابِ المُبينِ» ka matlab:

intro.en: Practise writing your own opinion in Arabic. Give your view on short statements, write a short topic on Arabic as a world language, and describe how you learn a language that is not your own.
intro.ur: Apni raaye Arabi mein likhne ki mashq. Mukhtasar bayanaat par apni raaye likhein, Arabi aalmi zubaan par mazmoon likhein aur batayein ke aap ghair zubaan kaise seekhte hain.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى كِتابَةِ رَأْيِكَ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ: اِكْتُبْ رَأْيَكَ في عِباراتٍ قَصيرَةٍ، وَاكْتُبْ مَوْضوعاً قَصيراً عَنِ العَرَبِيَّةِ لُغَةً عالَمِيَّةً، وَصِفْ كَيْفَ تَتَعَلَّمُ لُغَةً لَيْسَتْ لُغَتَكَ.

q.ur: «هَلْ تُوافِقُ أَمْ لا؟» kya poochta hai?
q.ar: ماذا نَسْأَلُ بِقَوْلِنا «هَلْ تُوافِقُ أَمْ لا؟»

q.ur: «اُكْتُبْ رَأْيَكَ» ka matlab:
«لُغَةٌ واحِدَةٌ» ka matlab:
«مَوْضوع» ka matlab:

intro.en: The connecting hamzah is written as a plain alif, whether it is pronounced or not, with any vowel. Example: اِسْمٌ (not إِسْمٌ), اِمْرَأَةٌ، اُدْخُلْ. Also, the alif of ال is dropped when the lam of a preposition comes before it: لِلْمُلْكِ.
intro.ur: Hamzat-ul-wasl sada alif ke taur par likha jata hai, chahe bola jaye ya na bola jaye, aur chahe uski harkat kuch bhi ho. Misal: اِسْمٌ (إِسْمٌ nahin), اِمْرَأَةٌ، اُدْخُلْ. Jab ال se pehle lam-e-jar aaye to ال ka alif gir jata hai: لِلْمُلْكِ.
intro.ar: تُكْتَبُ هَمْزَةُ الوَصْلِ أَلِفاً بِلا هَمْزَةٍ سَواءٌ نُطِقَتْ أَمْ لا: اِسْمٌ، اِمْرَأَةٌ، اُدْخُلْ. وَتُحْذَفُ أَلِفُ «ال» إِذا سَبَقَتْها لامُ الجَرِّ: لِلْمُلْكِ.

q.ur: 'Naam' ki durust imla kaun si hai?
«ما إِسْمُكَ؟» ki durust shakl:

q.en: What happens to the alif of ال after the preposition لِ?
q.ur: لِ ke baad ال ke alif ka kya hota hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَحْدُثُ لِأَلِفِ «ال» بَعْدَ لامِ الجَرِّ؟

q.ur: 'Andar aao' ki durust imla:
q.ar: ما الكِتابَةُ الصَّحيحَةُ لِفِعْلِ الأَمْرِ مِنْ «دَخَلَ»؟
